system.description: A Focus for a subtle operative who gets where others cannot.

abilities.name: Fast Talk
abilities.description: Convince a nonhostile intelligent creature to take one reasonable action.

abilities.name: Letting Their Guard Down
abilities.description: Successful disguise or deception reveals useful minor information.

abilities.name: Master of Disguise
abilities.description: Create and maintain a disguise quickly, with an extra asset under scrutiny.

abilities.name: Natural Sneak
abilities.description: Low rolls on infiltration tasks count as 6; Effort raises that minimum.

abilities.name: Awareness
abilities.description: Sense living creatures at long range until a recovery.

abilities.name: Flight Not Fight
abilities.description: Using an action only to move eases dodges until your next turn.

abilities.name: Blend In
abilities.description: Appear unimportant and gain two assets to dodge and stealth while unnoticed.

abilities.name: Defend and Respond
abilities.description: After blocking or dodging a melee attack, make an immediate melee attack.

abilities.name: Scrutinize Defenses
abilities.description: Study an area to ask the GM truthful questions about its defenses.

abilities.name: Convenient Device
abilities.description: Produce a one-use tool that removes a harmful condition; its cost matches the effect.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.description: Become invisible until you reveal your position; Effort can affect a creature you touch.

abilities.name: Persistence Training
abilities.description: End mind control or a disabling effect affecting you; Effort can help an ally.

abilities.name: Brainwashing
abilities.description: Control a touched creature of level 3 or lower after a successful Intellect attack.

abilities.name: Spring Away
abilities.description: After dodging danger, immediately move a short distance.
